episodes.synopsis: Defeated by the Black King, the Volunteer Army and its allies regroup.
episodes.title: Light and Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Aram becomes friends with Yuri and the gang. They realize that Pirika must be alive, and set out.
episodes.title: To Be With Others

episodes.synopsis: Aram is offered a good sword by Dusty, serving only to further upset Burckhardt. Their strained relationship, compounded by Burckhardt's baggage, causes unforeseen problems.
episodes.title: Symbol of Loyalty

episodes.synopsis: The gang finds their way to the Sage's Tower in search of leads on Pirika. They are not given a very warm welcome.
episodes.title: The Expanding Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Aram and Yuri are stranded in Maze Pass. They learn more about each other, and discover some unlikely allies and enemies.
episodes.title: Snowy Mountain Screams

episodes.synopsis: With Shuza going after the Chain Chronicle, Juliana makes the decision to succeed the throne.
episodes.title: The Nadir of Anguish

episodes.synopsis: Having lost Yuri to the Black Army, Aram and Phoena press onwards to Spirit Island to find answers as to Pirika's whereabouts—and to how they might save Yuri.
episodes.title: Torn Apart

episodes.synopsis: Phoena and Aram make it to Yggdra, where they meet an administrator. They scan through the Chronicle in search of answers.
episodes.title: Unyielding Will

episodes.synopsis: Phoena and Aram arrive at the Desert City to seek the help of Musica, who they hope can awaken a dragon with her voice.
episodes.title: The Flower in the Desert

episodes.synopsis: Phoena and Aram escort Musica aboard the Ark. They infiltrate the Black King's fortress.
episodes.title: The Sword That Rends Darkness

episodes.synopsis: The Black King Suppression Army engages the Black King's army in the final battle. Meanwhile, the Black King captures Phoena.
episodes.title: Live by the Sword, Die by the Sword

episodes.synopsis: With the end of the world imminent, Phoena takes it upon herself to absorb Black Element in order to buy time.
episodes.title: The Light of Haecceitas
